payload.summary: From codex-shims-agents-md implementation (mzqsfat9): codex custom prompts (~/.codex/prompts, home-only, flat) are deprecated upstream in favor of codex SKILLS, which support repo-level sharing. A codex-skills install target would restore repo-travelling shims (the preferred model — shims via git). Current prompts target works on codex-cli 0.145.0; revisit when skills-based discovery stabilizes. See ADR-0005 addendum + upstream openai/codex #4734 / #9848.
